# dz-sandbox

> Deterministic, 100% offline-first local sandbox simulating Algerian payment, courier, and banking APIs (Chargily Pay v2, SATIM, Yalidine, BaridiMob).

## Overview
dz-sandbox allows developers and AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot) to integrate and test Algerian e-commerce and fintech happy paths as well as real-world failure edge cases locally without merchant accounts, live credentials, or internet access.

## Base URLs & Ports
- Control API & Dashboard: http://127.0.0.1:4000
- Chargily Pay v2 Mock: http://127.0.0.1:4001/api/v2
- SATIM E-Payment Mock: http://127.0.0.1:4002/payment/rest
- Yalidine Express Mock: http://127.0.0.1:4003/v1
- BaridiMob Banking Mock: http://127.0.0.1:4004/mobilebank/service

## Quick CLI Commands for AI Agents
- Start all mock servers: `npx dz-sandbox start`
- Check health & active scenarios: `npx dz-sandbox status`
- Reset state: `npx dz-sandbox reset`
- Set global scenario: `npx dz-sandbox scenario set <provider> <scenario>`
- Advance virtual clock: `curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4000/__control/clock/advance -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"duration":"2h"}'`
- Export reproducible state: `npx dz-sandbox export repro.json`
- Stop daemon: `npx dz-sandbox stop`

## Per-Request Scenario Header
AI agents can trigger simulated failure behaviors on individual HTTP requests by passing the header:
`X-DZ-Scenario: <scenario_name>`

### Common Failure Scenarios
- `declined`: Simulates card issuer payment rejection
- `insufficient_funds`: Simulates empty account balance
- `timeout`: Simulates 504 Gateway Timeout
- `duplicate_webhook`: Dispatches two identical webhooks to verify idempotent handling
- `delayed_webhook`: Delays webhook delivery to test race conditions
- `webhook_bad_signature`: Sends tampered HMAC-SHA256 signature to verify authentication
- `rate_limited`: Returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
- `invalid_wilaya`: Yalidine commune/wilaya mismatch (HTTP 422)
- `otp_timeout`: BaridiMob mobile banking SMS OTP expiration

## Client Libraries
- TypeScript/JavaScript: `@dz-sandbox/client`
- Python (zero-dependency): `packages/python-client` (`from dz_sandbox import SandboxClient`)
- PHP / Laravel (zero-dependency): `packages/php-client` (`use DzSandbox\SandboxClient`)
